DOP: dassāvi(n) ( and ifc -dassāvina), mfn. [ BHS darśāvin; cf S. darśivas], who has seen; who goes to see, attends; seeing ; D II 328, 9 (jaccandho puriso … evaṃ vadeyya natthi kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni natthi kaṇhasukkānaṃ rūpānaṃ ~ī); M I 8, 33 (sutavā … ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ ~ī); S IV 193, 14 (puriso kiṃsukassa ~ī); Ap 156, 15 (te me puṭṭhā viyākaṃsu yathā ~ino tathā); Ps I 21, 34 (soṇasigālādayo pi ca cakkhunā ariye passanti na ca te ariyānaṃ ~ino); Th-a II 125, 25 (amataddaso ti nibbānassa ~ī); Sadd 869, 23 (gamituṃ sīlaṃ pakati yassa so hoti gāmī evaṃ … ~ī); — ifc see anāvaraṇa- ( sv āvaraṇa ), anicca- (s v nicca), abhikkanta- ( sv abhikkamati ), ādīnava-, ānisaṃsa-, nibbāna-, paralokavajjabhaya- ( sv para ), bhaya-, sabba-; — adassāvi(n) , mfn. , who has not seen; who does not go to see, to attend ; M I 1, 12 (idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ ~ī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto; Ps I 21, 28 foll. : yo tesaṃ ariyānaṃ adassanasīlo na ca dassane sādhukārī so ariyānaṃ ~ī ti veditabbo, so ca cakkhunā ~ī ñāṇena ~ī ti duvidho, tesu ñāṇena ~ī idha adhippeto); Dhs 1003.
